# Seasonally Living by Chim Chimney

> Showroom in Wenatchee, Washington (1407 Maiden Ln, next to Home Depot) for Stûv wood stoves, inserts and fireplaces, stove and fireplace venting and chimney service, Cal Spas hot tubs, swim spas and pools. Serves Wenatchee, East Wenatchee, Leavenworth, Chelan, Cashmere and Manson.

- Phone: (509) 667-8833
- Email: sales@seasonallyliving.com
- Showroom hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 10am to 4pm. Sunday and Monday by appointment.

## Pages

- [Fireplaces & stoves (Stûv)](https://seasonallyliving.com/fireplaces): Stûv wood stoves, inserts and fireplaces, with venting designed and installed by our crew.
- [Venting & service](https://seasonallyliving.com/service): venting design and install, chimney liners, inspections, sweeps, hot tub service, seasonal open and close.
- [Hot tubs](https://seasonallyliving.com/hot-tubs): Cal Spas hot tubs, try-outs in the showroom, delivery, setup and orientation.
- [Swim spas](https://seasonallyliving.com/swim-spas): dry consults in winter, wet tests April to September.
- [Pools](https://seasonallyliving.com/pools): design consults over the winter for spring builds.
- [Visit / book](https://seasonallyliving.com/visit): book a showroom visit, consult or service call.
